text: This report is seeking approval to recognize the One of a Kind's 50th Year Anniversary at Exhibition Place with a ceremonial name change of Nunavut Road (West of Enercare Centre) to "One of a Kind Road" on the opening day of the show. The site plan for Nunavut Road is outlined in Appendix 'A' to this report.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved a ceremonial renaming of Nunavut Road to One of a Kind Road, outlined in Appendix 'A' to the report (October 17, 2025) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, in celebration of the One of a Kind Show’s 50th Anniversary at Exhibition Place, effective on the opening day of their show, November 27, 2025, for one day.
